name: Window film and tinting
summary: How expats commission residential window film in Singapore for heat and glare — condo approval, UV claims, and west-sun rooms that cook afternoons.
body:
Window film cuts heat and glare in west-facing condos without full curtain blackout. Automotive tint shops sometimes cross into residential work; dedicated film installers usually understand glass types better.

## Use cases
- West-sun living rooms and home offices
- UV fade reduction for flooring/art
- Daytime privacy films on low floors
- Mild shatter-resistance add-ons (not security glass substitutes)
- Rental-friendly removable options when allowed

MCST rules may restrict exterior appearance — check before shiny mirror films go up.

## How to choose
Ask for visible light transmission and heat rejection specs in writing. Prefer installers who clean edges carefully (bubbles in humidity appear later). Get warranties on adhesive failure. Compare against blinds/curtains if landlord forbids film.

## Practical tip
Test a sample square on one pane for a week before full-flat install. Photograph glass condition beforehand — scratches get disputed after film goes on.
